payment.title: Payment options
payment.intro: On BetMatchBonus, deposits and withdrawals are handled through a secure, controlled process. You can track the current status of your transactions in your profile under Transaction history.
payment.depositAfterText: After a successful deposit, your balance is updated immediately.
payment.withdrawalOnlyPrefix: Withdrawals can be initiated only from the
payment.withdrawalOnlySuffix: , and bonus balance cannot be paid out directly.
payment.important1: The account holder name must match the full name provided during registration.
payment.important2: Incorrect or incomplete bank details may delay or reject the withdrawal.
payment.important3: You can view the total value of deposited and winnings balance on the Deposit and Withdrawal page.
payment.important4: If a bonus is active, related requirements (turnover, minimum selections, minimum odds) are mandatory.

playerProtection.title: Player protection
playerProtection.intro: BetMatchBonus is committed to responsible gaming. Betting is entertainment, not a source of income. Please always play consciously, with a predefined budget and controlled decisions.
playerProtection.principle1: Only use money you can afford to lose without causing problems.
playerProtection.principle2: Set your own daily/weekly financial limit and stick to it.
playerProtection.principle3: Do not try to recover losses with quick, impulsive bets.
playerProtection.principle4: Do not make betting decisions under alcohol influence or strong emotional stress.
playerProtection.warningIntro: It is worth taking a break if you experience several of the following:
playerProtection.warning1: your concentration, sleep, or mood worsens because of gambling,
playerProtection.warning2: you place higher stakes for the same level of excitement,
playerProtection.warning3: you hide your betting activity from people around you,
playerProtection.warning4: you continue playing despite financial difficulties.
playerProtection.action1: Take at least a 24-48 hour break and reassess your relationship with gambling.
playerProtection.action2: Reduce your activity and use lower stakes.
playerProtection.action3: Talk to someone you trust (family member, friend, professional).
playerProtection.action4: If needed, seek professional help from organizations specialized in gambling addiction.

infoSecurity.title: Information security
infoSecurity.intro: The BetMatchBonus platform protects user data with multiple layers of technical and operational safeguards. Our goal is to keep account usage, transactions, and personal data handling secure, transparent, and verifiable.
infoSecurity.account1: Use a strong, unique password that you do not use on other websites.
infoSecurity.account2: Always sign out after use on public or shared devices.
infoSecurity.account3: Regularly check your profile and transaction history.
infoSecurity.account4: If you notice suspicious activity, change your password immediately.
infoSecurity.data1: The platform applies role-based access control.
infoSecurity.data2: Sensitive operations (for example login and fund movement) are logged.
infoSecurity.data3: Personal data is handled according to the applicable privacy policy.
infoSecurity.data4: In case of unusual behavior, the account may be placed under additional security review.
infoSecurity.tip1: Never share your login credentials through messages or phone calls.
infoSecurity.tip2: Only log in from trusted networks.
infoSecurity.tip3: Check your browser address bar and sign in only on the official site.
infoSecurity.tip4: If you suspect phishing, do not click links and contact customer support.

complaints.title: Complaint handling
complaints.intro: BetMatchBonus aims to provide fast, transparent, and fair support. If you have a remark, objection, or complaint, we investigate every case and strive for a prompt and clear resolution.
complaints.submitTitle: How can you submit a complaint?
complaints.submitIntro: Please submit your complaint in writing and include the following where possible:
complaints.submit1: your username or registered email address,
complaints.submit3: a short and factual description of the issue,
complaints.process1: Incoming complaints are recorded in our system.
complaints.process2: The case is investigated based on relevant data (logs, transactions, betting history).
complaints.process3: You receive a written response with the outcome and the reasoning behind the decision.
complaints.process4: If needed, we initiate further clarification to close the case quickly.
complaints.responseText: In most cases, complaints are processed within a short timeframe. More complex cases may require longer investigation, and we will inform you accordingly. Please provide all relevant information accurately, as this significantly speeds up case handling.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Our customer support team is here to assist every user quickly and clearly. If you have questions about your account, deposits, withdrawals, bonuses, or bets, contact us.
contact.help4: checking betting events, slips, and results.
contact.beforeIntro: For faster handling, prepare the following details:
contact.before1: your username or registered email address,
contact.before3: a short and precise description of the issue,
contact.before4: if available, a screenshot or timestamp.
contact.responseText: Simple requests are usually answered within a short time. Cases requiring complex technical or financial checks may take longer. In every case, we aim to provide the fastest possible and detailed response.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains in plain language how we process user data in the BetMatchBonus system. During data processing, we aim for transparency, security, and legal compliance.
privacy.s1Intro: To operate the service and manage user accounts, the following data categories may be processed:
privacy.s1Item1: account data: username, email address, and technical data related to passwords,
privacy.s1Item2: profile data: full name and related identification data,
privacy.s1Item3: financial data: deposit/withdrawal transactions and balances,
privacy.s1Item4: betting data: slips, stakes, odds, and results,
privacy.s1Item5: technical data: session and log data, security events.
privacy.s2Intro: We process data especially for the following purposes:
privacy.s2Item2: providing betting services and processing transactions,
privacy.s2Item3: fulfilling legal obligations (for example accounting and complaint handling),
privacy.s2Item4: preventing abuse and maintaining system security,
privacy.s3Intro: Depending on the case, data processing is based on:
privacy.s3Item1: performance of a contract (user account and service provision),
privacy.s3Item3: legitimate interest (for example fraud prevention and system security),
privacy.s4Text: We store data only for as long as necessary. Retention periods are determined by service operation, legal obligations, and legitimate interest. After the retention period expires, data is deleted or anonymized.
privacy.s5Text: We protect data against unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or loss through appropriate technical and organizational measures. Security controls are reviewed continuously.
privacy.s6Intro: Users have several rights regarding data processing, including:
privacy.s7Text: For questions or requests related to data processing, please contact our customer support. In case of complaint, you are entitled to contact the competent supervisory authority.
privacy.footerNote: We may update this notice from time to time so it reflects service development and the current legal framework.

participation.title: Participation rules
participation.intro: These rules define the core terms for using the BetMatchBonus platform. By using the service, the user accepts these rules and undertakes to use the platform in good faith and in accordance with applicable laws.
participation.s1Text: A valid registration is required to use the service. Users must provide real and accurate data and keep it up to date. User accounts are personal and may not be transferred or shared.
participation.s2Item1: Keeping login credentials confidential is the responsibility of the user.
participation.s2Item2: Actions initiated from an account are attributable to the account holder.
participation.s2Item3: In case of suspicious activity, the provider may apply security checks.
participation.s2Item4: Violation of the rules may result in account restriction or suspension.
participation.s3Text: A bet is considered validly placed only when the system confirms it. Before placing a bet, the user is responsible for checking the stake amount, selected events, odds, and bet type. Accepted bets generally cannot be modified afterward.
participation.s4Text: Use of bonuses is always subject to conditions. These may include minimum deposit, minimum selections, minimum odds, expiration, and turnover requirements. Without meeting the relevant conditions, the benefit cannot be enforced.
participation.s5Text: Withdrawals are made by bank transfer, taking into account the configured minimum amount. Withdrawals may only be initiated from the winnings balance. The provider may verify the accuracy and consistency of withdrawal details.
participation.s6Text: Any activity aimed at disrupting system operation, bypassing promotional conditions, or gaining unauthorized advantage is prohibited. If abuse is suspected, the provider may take temporary or permanent measures.
participation.s7Text: The provider does everything reasonably expected to ensure continuous operation, but is not liable for disruptions caused by external circumstances beyond its control.
participation.s8Text: The provider reserves the right to amend these participation rules. Continued use of the service after publication of amended terms constitutes acceptance of the updated rules.
